rooms.name: Grand Entrance
rooms.description: A high-ceilinged hall with polished marble floors. A large banner welcomes visitors to the 'Abstract Perspectives' exhibition. The Main Gallery is to the north and the Cafe is to the east.

rooms.name: Main Gallery
rooms.description: Minimalist white walls display vibrant oil paintings. A security guard stands alert in the corner. To the west lies the Sculptures Room, and to the north is the private Staff Office.

npcs.name: Guard
npcs.description: A focused security guard in a grey uniform.

dialogs.strict: Good day. Please do not touch the artwork. The staff office is off-limits without a badge.
dialogs.happy: I see you have the badge. You may proceed to the office.

rooms.name: Museum Cafe
rooms.description: The smell of freshly ground coffee fills the air. It is quiet here. A leather bag is forgotten on one of the chairs.

items.name: badge
items.description: A plastic ID card with the museum logo. It belongs to the senior curator.

rooms.name: Sculptures Room
rooms.description: Natural light streams from the skylights onto various bronze and stone figures. An elderly woman is examining a bust. The Main Gallery is back to the east. There is a large exit to the south leading outside.

npcs.name: Curator
npcs.description: An elegant woman with sharp eyes and a welcoming smile.

dialogs.neutral: Welcome to our collection. I'm looking for the exhibition catalog; it's quite rare.
dialogs.happy: Thank you for finding the catalog! You have a keen eye for detail. I'll unlock the exit for you.

rooms.name: Staff Office
rooms.description: A cluttered office filled with books, magnifying glasses, and shipment crates. On the desk lies a thick, bound book.

items.name: catalog
items.description: A rare, leather-bound catalog of the current exhibition.

rooms.name: Outside
rooms.description: You step out of the gallery, having solved the mystery. You breathe in the fresh air... YOU WIN!
